operator_profiler: torch.profiler one representative operator window during a complete training run
kernel_profiler: rocprofv3 kernel/memory-copy/marker traces with ROCTx training-window filtering
representative_timeline: fixed four-batch rocprofv3 Perfetto trace for visualization only
reason_for_separate_passes: PyTorch operator profiling and rocprofv3 tracing are separated to avoid profiler interference. The short third pass retains a readable Perfetto timeline without using it for quantitative metrics.
